# llms.txt for crisariza.com

## Site Overview
Personal site and portfolio of Cristian Ariza, a senior product engineer who ships TypeScript back ends, React Native apps and AI agents in production. Based in Buenos Aires, working remotely with US time zones.

## Site Structure
- `/` - Home: intro, selected projects and experience
- `/projects` - All case studies
- `/projects/[slug]` - One case study: problem, role, architecture, highlights, results and stack
- `/about` - About page
- `/resume` - Resume (PDF)

## Case Studies
- `/projects/lito` - Lito, a production AI agent on WhatsApp for a health insurer
- `/projects/premedic` - Premedic members app and API layer
- `/projects/lanus-id` - Lanús ID single sign-on and digital tickets
- `/projects/estadisticas` - Estadísticas, a century of club history as data
- `/projects/ramonin` - Ramonín, the club's AI assistant
- `/projects/lanus-platform` - Club Lanús design system, designed in Figma and shipped as code
- `/projects/soffi` - Soffi launch site
